{{Quote|Her grandfather was in the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force, back when they first made their treaty with the Sith. His team was assigned to get some extra collateral, in case the relationship went sour.|[[Pova]]|<ref name="Chasing Copero">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20171116|text="Chasing Copero"|int=Chasing Copero}}</ref>}}
A '''treaty'''<ref name="Chasing Copero" /> was negotiated between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The exact details of the treaty remained a mystery to all but the highest-ranking officials of the Empire and the Ascendancy.<ref name="Chiss Ascendancy" />
